explanation: I grepped Mathlib for `stabilizer_ne_top` and for stabilizer = ⊤ statements. The only close match is `Equiv.Perm.stabilizer_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_nonempty_compl` in Mathlib/GroupTheory/Perm/MaximalSubgroups.lean. It is about `stabilizer (Perm α) s`, not `alternatingGroup α`. Its hypothesis is also weaker (`sᶜ.Nonempty`, not `sᶜ.Nontrivial`). Passing from `Perm α` to the alternating group would need an extra argument, so it is not a one- or two-line derivation. The alternating-group statement has no other counterpart.
